_note: Hand-filled where the game files do not say where a Slasher lore item is. Keyed by EditorID. location = text shown on the page; mapImage / locationImage = full /wp-content/uploads/... paths if you did not use the default names (guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Lore/<item-name-slug>-map.avif and -location.avif); image = the row picture (notes: <slug>-note.avif, holotapes: holotape.avif). noFixedPlace: true = the item has no set spot in the world (mask order, random grave, enemy drop, quest delivery); the page then shows only the text, no map/location picture boxes. obtainLink: {label, text, url} = a link line shown inside How to Obtain (e.g. the mask notes -> Pint-Sized Slasher Masks Spawn Locations).

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note01.location: Pops up when you pick up your 1st Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Eldritch_Equations' 1st mask was on the car at Dino Peaks Mini Golf.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note02.location: Pops up when you pick up your 3rd Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Eldritch_Equations' 3rd mask was in the shack at Dino Peaks Mini Golf.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note03.location: Pops up when you pick up your 5th Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Eldritch_Equations' 5th mask was at the ticket booth at Starlight Drive-in.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_Note05.location: Pops up when you pick up your 10th Pint-Sized Slasher Mask, wherever that mask is, so the spot depends on the order you collect them. For example: Eldritch_Equations' 10th mask was on the deck chair at Tycoon Lake.

SDOW_MQ01_Bodies_FinalMessage.location: In the bloody mess at the dog kennel. Read "A page torn from a children's book", investigate the area it describes, then search the dog kennel the quest marks.

SDOW_MQ01_BroadcastRecording.location: The holotape drops into your inventory, so there's nothing to go and find.

SDOW_MQ02_Graves_Holotape.location: On the Smiling Clown at Tyler County Fairgrounds, after reading "Our Mission - Part IV" ("Seek your fortune").

SDOW_MQ02_Graves_Journal01.location: Dug up from a Disturbed Grave. Read a Pint-Sized Phantoms' Map (a reward from activities and events) and dig at the grave it marks; each grave gives you the next page. The grave is picked at random, so the spot changes (the Pint-Sized Phantoms Grave Sites guide shows them all). For example: Eldritch_Equations' Part I came from the grave at Lady Janet's Soft Serve.

SDOW_MQ04_Infestations_Note01.location: In whichever of the two trunks you open first: the steamer trunk in Gauley Mine or the trunk in RobCo Research Center. The pictures are from Eldritch_Equations, who did Gauley Mine first.

SDOW_MQ04_Infestations_Note03.location: On the Pint-Sized Phantom Tinkerer in Organ Cave, together with "The Summoning" holotape. Read "Phantoms' Orders: His Vessel" to send you to Organ Cave, defeat the Tinkerer, then search him. It isn't in either trunk.

SDOW_MQ04_Infestations_Holotape.location: On the Pint-Sized Phantom Tinkerer in Organ Cave. Defeat him, then search him.

SDOW_Note_Initiation01.location: Dropped by Pint-Sized Phantoms once you've finished The Slasher: Masked Truth, so there's no set spot. For example: Eldritch_Equations got this one from a Phantom inside RobCo Research Center.
